headlines.title: New Supreme Court term begins with justices stumped by climate change case
headlines.description: The justices return from summer break to hear arguments in a lawsuit Boulder, Colorado, brought against Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy.

headlines.title: Researcher at Russian Lab Dies After Potential Plague Exposure
headlines.description: A researcher at a lab in Siberia has died after potentially being exposed to pneumonic plague, according to reports. Now, almost 200 people are reportedly under quarantine in the wake of that death, with the incident putting health officials around the world on alert. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Ford CEO says it's his company's responsibility to bring more affordable vehicles to the U.S.
headlines.description: Americans are still buying cars, but they're borrowing record amounts of money and taking on longer car loans to help make ends meet. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Ford CEO Jim Farley, who said his company has five more-affordable vehicles on the way.

headlines.title: Cornell President Releases Video Statement as Controversy Grows
headlines.description: Tensions are continuing to escalate on the campus of Cornell University with student protests ramping up, including a confrontation with one of the seven fraternity members accused of sexual assault. It comes as the Ivy League’s president is speaking out about the scandal for the first time. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Plea agreement hearing set for ex-CIA officer found with gold bars
headlines.description: A plea agreement hearing has been set for Tuesday in the case of an ex-CIA officer found with 303 gold bars

headlines.title: Trump Rallies for Republicans Ahead of Midterm Elections
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is making a major push in once-reliable Republican states as a new NBC News poll shows his party could be facing an uphill battle ahead of the midterm elections. It comes as new Trump ads, paid for by taxpayers, get prime-time air, some during football games. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was killed on his way to work by ICE agents, who said he used his vehicle as a weapon. The community is demanding justice.

headlines.title: Russia pounds Kyiv during German chancellor’s visit in a new escalation
headlines.description: Germany’s leader faced a grim new reality as his train pulled into Kyiv: air raid sirens and the boom of Russian strikes on the Ukrainian capital.

headlines.title: Where you live matters when it comes to prosecuting rape suspects
headlines.description: A murderer can be convicted decades after committing the crime, because there is no statute of limitations on most homicides in America.

headlines.title: ‘It’s not enough to not rape somebody’: How parents are talking to kids about Cornell
headlines.description: Parents are using Jane Doe’s case to talk to their sons about resisting peer pressure and stepping in when something’s wrong, even if it means challenging their friends.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Some Democrats don’t expect to fill a Supreme Court vacancy under Trump
headlines.description: Minority Leader Chuck Schumer is putting President Donald Trump on notice: If Democrats win the Senate, they don’t intend to put “MAGA” judges on the courts.
